title: Concept: Solr error detail disclosed in a response
description: An Apache Solr exception block in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Solr errors repeat the core, collection and field names, which exposes the search schema of indexed customer records.
applicability: Deployments that render an Apache Solr exception block into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Solr errors repeat the core, collection and field names, which exposes the search schema of indexed customer records.
